info.title: DailySpeak API
info.description: HTTP API for DailySpeak. Authenticated endpoints use the `daily_speaking_session` HTTP-only cookie set by login/register.

post.summary: Register a user and create a session
Sign in and create a session

get.description: Uses optional auth cookie. If authenticated, the user's saved English level overrides the `level` query parameter.

parameters.name: avoid
parameters.description: Questions to avoid; may be repeated.

questions: How do you usually plan a short trip?
What technology helps you study better?
How do you keep a healthy morning routine?

get.summary: Generate follow-up questions and words for a topic
Load user profile data, recordings, quota and subscription

post.summary: Activate or extend subscription by one month
Save a full base64 recording for background processing
post.description: Legacy/fallback upload flow. Backend saves the recording immediately, returns it with `status=processing`, then runs transcription, AI suggestions, and the natural conversational rewrite in separate background steps.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a recording and related feed content
delete.description: Deletes the owned recording, its Feed publication, replies and reactions, and durably queues recording and reply audio files for removal from server storage.

post.description: Atomically claims an owned failed recording and resumes from its stored processing stage. Transcription reuses saved audio; AI analysis reuses the transcript; the natural rewrite reuses both the transcript and accepted suggestions. An already-processing recording is returned without starting a duplicate job.

200.description: Current recording state and whether a new retry job was scheduled.

post.summary: Generate pronunciation audio for the corrected transcript
post.description: Claims an owned recording for background Cartesia synthesis. Ready or recently processing recordings are returned without starting a duplicate job.

200.description: Current recording state after scheduling or deduplication.

post.summary: Upload the final complete recording audio
post.description: Uploads the complete browser-created Blob for the session. Backend prefers this file over raw chunk concatenation when finishing the recording.

post.summary: Finish chunked upload and start background processing

200.description: Session was already finalized; existing recording returned.

post.summary: Publish a saved recording to the feed
Create a voice reply for a feed post
Set or clear current user's reaction for a post

get.description: Returns a persisted shadowing MP3 only when the session user owns the recording whose active shadowing URL matches this path. Directory requests are rejected.
Serves recording and Feed media. Shadowing MP3s use the authenticated route documented separately.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path under the configured uploads directory, for example `recordings/user-id/recording.webm`.

cookieAuth.name: daily_speaking_session
cookieAuth.description: HTTP-only session cookie set by `/api/auth/register` and `/api/auth/login`.

InterestQuery.name: interest
InterestQuery.description: Interest ids; may be repeated. Backend keeps up to 10.

AuthUserOK.description: Authenticated user. Response also sets `daily_speaking_session` on login/register.

Unauthorized.description: Session cookie is missing or invalid.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Valid request, but audio could not be transcribed.

AudioDataUrl.description: A `data:audio/*;base64,...` payload for incoming requests, or `/uploads/...` URL in stored responses.

reaction.description: Set one reaction. Use null or empty string to clear current reaction.
